description: Apply one action to up to 200 time entries in a matter at once: approve, revert_to_draft, mark_billable, or mark_non_billable. Entries that are not in the action's starting state are skipped and only the number of changed rows is returned. Approval is refused while any selected entry has a running timer or a billable entry has no rate; mark_billable re-resolves each entry's rate and is refused when one of them has no effective rate.
